class.name: VisionOSAnchorTracker
class.brief_description: A tracker for a visionOS world anchor.
class.description: Represents an ARKit world anchor: a position in the user's surroundings that the system persists across sessions and re-locates automatically. Create these through [method VisionOSXRInterface.create_spatial_anchor] or [method VisionOSSpatialAnchorCapability.create_new_anchor]. An anchor may temporarily stop being tracked when the user moves away from it; watch [signal tracking_state_changed] to react.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], ARKit is currently tracking this anchor and its pose is valid.
The UUID ARKit assigned to this anchor. Store it to identify the anchor again in a later session.
If [code]true[/code], this anchor is shared with nearby SharePlay participants.

signal.name: tracking_state_changed
signal.description: Emitted when ARKit starts or stops tracking this anchor.
